source.title: Heavy Tailed Random Matrices: How They Differ from the GOE, and Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized zbMATH URL to identifier 7040547. zbMATH API returned DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-01593-0_15 and the title; this was used as resolver metadata only.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI resolves to the Springer chapter page, which exposes only title, abstract, references, and subscription/buy-chapter controls rather than the full technical source containing problem statements.
Crossref returned the same DOI, title, and a Springer PDF candidate. OpenAlex confirmed open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, no OA URL, no best OA location, and no repository full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the exact title, the title plus PDF, and the title plus Alice Guionnet. Inspected candidates were ResearchGate, OUCI, the Springer book/chapter pages, CEA/library or bookseller listings, and a table-of-contents PDF; all were request-full-text, metadata/reference-only, subscription preview, catalog/listing, or table-of-contents only, so no readable exact-work PDF or HTML full text was accepted.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. No open-problem questions were extracted from metadata, abstracts, snippets, or citation records.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-7040547.json and outputs/latest.json.
